categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in four segments: audio-video software products and solutions, system integration and services, VR business products and services, and game and cloud services. Its main revenue source is system integration and services for the broadcasting industry, with growing focus on VR/MR content, hardware, applications, and cloud-based gaming services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including 5G, ultra-high-definition (4K/8K) video streaming, AI-powered super-resolution, VR/MR spatial computing, and cloud computing. It develops proprietary IP video platforms, CDN systems, VR cameras with real-time stitching and streaming, and AI-enabled VR/MR live broadcasting solutions. The company also integrates hardware and software for immersive VR content production and distribution.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include provincial and municipal broadcasting network operators, telecom operators (China Mobile, China Unicom, China Telecom), government and enterprise clients, and individual consumers in the VR and gaming markets. The company serves the broadcasting industry primarily, while expanding into telecom 5G, VR/AR, metaverse, and cloud gaming sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China, with significant business in regions such as Northeast, North China, East China, South China, Central China, Northwest, and Southwest China. It also has subsidiaries and operations in Hong Kong and engages in overseas projects like the Papua New Guinea digital TV project.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, providing end-to-end audio-video software solutions, system integration services, VR content production, and gaming/cloud services. It collaborates with upstream content providers and hardware manufacturers and serves downstream telecom and broadcasting operators and end users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include technology-driven upgrades focusing on 5G, cloud computing, AI, ultra-HD video, and VR/MR integration. The company emphasizes R&D in AI-powered super-resolution, spatial computing, VR/MR live streaming, and metaverse platforms. It aims to diversify products and services, optimize business structure, expand markets domestically and internationally, and integrate the industry chain through innovation and strategic partnerships.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of software products, system integration contracts, VR hardware and content services, and game/cloud service subscriptions or licensing. The company also earns from customized development, SaaS/PaaS cloud services, and strategic cooperation projects with telecom and broadcasting operators.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Digital Video (数码视讯), Yitong Technology (亿通科技), Jiecheng Co., and Lutong Shixin. The company positions itself as a comprehensive and innovative provider of end-to-end large video solutions with strong R&D capabilities and a broad product portfolio, holding a leading market position in the broadcasting industry and growing presence in telecom and VR sectors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 130.65 million, a decline of 11.03% year-over-year, with a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 66.62 million, though the loss narrowed by 13.58%. Total assets reached RMB 368.87 million, up 7.91%, and net assets attributable to shareholders increased by 24.03% to RMB 85.21 million. The company maintains high R&D investment at 19.42% of revenue, focusing on sustainable innovation despite recent losses.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive end-to-end large video solutions, integrating software, hardware, and cloud services with advanced technologies like AI, 5G, and VR/MR. Its unique value lies in ultra-low latency, high-definition video streaming, AI-enhanced content processing, and immersive VR experiences. It offers modular, scalable platforms with strong customization and integration capabilities, supported by deep industry experience and strategic partnerships with major operators.
